descFull: The storage layer Proxmox VE doesn't have, inside the Proxmox web UI. ZFS and mixed-size Hybrid RAID pools, SMB/NFS shares, an iSCSI target, snapshots and schedules, replication, backup and restore to PBS — as native panels on the PVE node. No appliance, no second login. AGPL-3.0.
